instruction: A candid documentary medium shot of a group of friends laughing on a rooftop terrace. On the far left, a man with a hair bun (R5) in a black shirt looks down next to a Black man with glasses (R6) in a white t-shirt. Beside them, a blonde woman (R1) in a colorful striped dress laughs heartily. In the center, a man in a white cap (R2) leans forward. To his right, a woman in a black sleeveless top (R4) and a dark-haired woman (R3) in a striped top laugh joyfully. On the far right, a woman with a curly afro (R7) in a striped dress smiles widely. The group is bathed in bright, natural daylight.
